first_judgments.claim: The ordinary AI item scan calls each CanUseInBattle check before classification with no selected move and with AI rather than battle context. A legal ETHER/MAXETHER/LEPPABERRY owner resource on an able subject can fail the selected-slot comparison before any healing item is selected, aborting the entire item phase. WP51 documents Max Mushrooms and broad exception handling but no concrete mixed-inventory failure contract. Need finish loaded overrides, legal default item/trainer schema, shared dispatcher and recovery proof.

WP51 original68–70/final76–78 explicitly states minimum-one weather harm for sand/hail/shadow sky but omits the same per-term minimum from the other residual estimate terms (e.g. Rain Dish −H/16). The approximation itself clamps each such contribution; it does not delegate to the real HP processor. Legal level1 Squirtle, HP IV/EV0 =>H11, HP9, active Rain Dish, rainDuration2, Curse true, no other terms: source estimated net loss max(floor11/4,1)−max(floor11/16,1)=1. Bare integer terms give2. Medium skill32 significant-eor-damage threshold is floor11/4=2 (also floor9/2=4), so the omitted minimum can reverse this wish-to-switch predicate. WP52-A original110/final120 delegates the complete estimate to WP51 rather than repairing it.
